title: Thermodynamic Dictionary for Syracuse-like Maps
summary: In this paper we estabilsh a dictionary between the behavior of a general map $f: X \to X$ which is defined by using a decomposition into disjoint subsets $X = A \cup B$ and the thermodynamic formalism. The approach of this paper is set theoretical, topological and ergodic.
